semantics.burnAlpha: v488 staking/recycle_alpha.rs takes signed coldkey, caps at available alpha, verifies unlock/collateral, burns alpha and emits actual AlphaBurned; recycling emits separate AlphaRecycled and is excluded.
semantics.addStakeBurn: Same source uses a transaction, stakes TAO, burns resulting alpha and emits AddStakeBurn after AlphaBurned. Retain existing match-by-netuid/hotkey/amount and count once; TAO input is not TAO burned.
semantics.gamma: v488 subnets/gamma.rs mint_gamma buys and burns alpha then emits GammaMinted without AlphaBurned. mint_gamma_with_stake calls do_burn_alpha then GammaMinted. GammaMinted added to new-runtime scan targets; if present reconcile with AlphaBurned to prevent double count. No GammaMinted events found through this cutoff.
semantics.allocation: v488 subnets/emission_weights.rs retains burn/recycle/owner/validator/miner in u64::MAX parts, combined burn/recycle cap33%, validator cap50%, miner floor33%, Root live baseline paid from validator slot and capped by it. Runtime change alone does not establish a changed allocation vector or enabled Gamma services.

runtimeReview.controls: Original known eTAO/burn decoding controls retained for every segment; every block runtime checked; all128 end-state vectors compared with public baseline; complete contiguous interval asserted.

SubnetIdentitiesV3.description: Ormas is an Outcomes API for coding work on Bittensor subnet 76, in development. Clients post a change and the test that proves it; miners quote a firm price for the passing result and deliver a branch. Miners will be paid only when independent validators accept the delivery, and clients will be charged the accepted quote and nothing on a miss. Protocol, thin client, reference miner and reference validator: MIT.
SubnetIdentitiesV3.additional: Ormas is operated by Heron Cove LLC, which issues invoices and commercial documentation for the service. Registered September 5, 2026; not a continuation of the former subnet 76. Commercial payments and subnet emissions are separate.
